evals.prompt: Use gtm-define-icp to create ICP definitions for Northstar Compliance's active fintech compliance outbound workspace. Use the existing workspace context and confirm the durable write preview.
evals.expected_output: A new workspaces/fintech-compliance-outbound/icps.md file with account-level ICP segments, a no-match segment, durable-write preview evidence, and an isolated auto-commit for the ICP file only.
expectations: The preview names workspaces/fintech-compliance-outbound/icps.md, sections to create, the commit message, and states no outreach, CRM update, campaign trigger, sync, remote push, or other external side effect will happen.
The created icps.md includes the three Northstar account ICP machine labels plus no-match, and does not include persona definitions.
Each created segment includes strong signals, disqualifiers, provenance/source notes, confidence, reasoning, needs_review, and open questions.
The auto-commit exists, uses the Create ICP definitions subject, and changes only workspaces/fintech-compliance-outbound/icps.md.
The GTM scaffold checker passes and local active registry state remains outside the GTM Context Repository.

evals.prompt: Use gtm-define-icp to refine Northstar Compliance's existing ICPs. Add an insurance claims operations signal and a service-provider caveat to the regulated B2B SaaS segment while preserving existing human-authored ICP content.
evals.expected_output: The existing icps.md is updated non-destructively, the requested signal and caveat are added once, human-authored notes are preserved, and auto-commit is skipped when target-file isolation is unclear.
expectations: The update preserves existing ICP segment labels, no-match, and a human-authored note instead of destructively replacing the file.
The regulated-b2b-saas segment includes the new insurance claims operations signal and service-provider caveat exactly once.
The updated icps.md has unique machine labels and exactly one no-match section.
The execution summary says auto-commit was skipped because the target file had pre-existing uncommitted edits, and says changes remain uncommitted with no push.
Unrelated pre-existing working-tree changes are left uncommitted and unstaged.

evals.prompt: Use gtm-define-icp from a directory with no GTM Context Project and no active registry.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops with the ADR 0086 missing-context wording and does not create files or perform git side effects.
expectations: The output includes the exact ADR 0086 missing-context failure wording.
No git repository is initialized and no durable side effects are performed.
